comparison.Updated November 15, 2026. The Audacity: Updated November 15, 2026. The Audacity columns compare the 3.7.9 and 4.0.2 source tags. This list focuses on features affected by the move to Audacity 4, with a few retained or restored features for context; it is not a complete feature list.
